raw_identity_hardening.original_finding: ConstructionObligationLedgerV2.schema_name and schema_version were const defaults but absent from JSON Schema required.
raw_identity_hardening.risk_resolved: The rebound V2 candidate requires both fields in raw JSON; omission now fails strict schema validation.
raw_identity_hardening.projection_receipt_note: The receipt is deterministic application output rather than model output; its builder already serializes identity fields. Receipt hardening may accompany the separate contract review but is not a grammar blocker.
raw_identity_hardening.nested_reference_note: Nested SourceSpanReference defaults are bound by the enclosing ledger schema identity. The grammar may omit repeated nested schema labels; role, source SHA-256, and offsets remain mandatory raw fields.

request_context: candidate source SHA-256, byte length, and ordered UTF-8 code-point boundary tuple
factual-authority SHA-256, byte length, and ordered UTF-8 code-point boundary tuple
frozen ledger and reference schema identities

field_contexts.candidate_span_ref: Force CANDIDATE role and candidate SHA-256.
field_contexts.vehicle_span_ref: Force CANDIDATE role and candidate SHA-256.
field_contexts.authority_support_ref: Permit null where semantically coherent; otherwise force FACTUAL_AUTHORITY role and authority SHA-256.

offset_generation: At start_utf8, offer only canonical base-10 strings for valid UTF-8 boundaries strictly before source byte length.
After selecting start_utf8, offer end_utf8 only from valid boundaries strictly greater than start_utf8.
No leading zero except the literal zero; no sign, fraction, exponent, whitespace, token offset, character offset, or out-of-range integer.
Boundary choices are request-derived finite literals, not free NUMBER mode.
The post-generation pure resolver and projection receipt remain authoritative defense-in-depth.
semantic_state: Preserve current construction-to-entry obligation projection, graph-link conditioning, enum coherence, cardinality ceilings, and coverage fail-closed logic.
Replace provenance STRING states only; free-text commitment, semantic_target, role_basis, and literal_path_basis remain JSON string states without evidence authority.
Grammar acceptance never implies semantic admission; V2 Pydantic, projection, graph, and semantic receipts remain separately required.

state_and_cache_requirements: The initial DFA state must be constructed from an immutable source constraint context; the current zero-argument tracker state is not reusable unchanged.
The incremental tracker must retain the identical context during extension and full rebuild paths.

Every projector cache key for reference modes must include case/source binding identity, field role, selected start boundary, and reference substate—or the projector cache must be strictly request-local with an asserted context identity.
No trie/cache object may be shared across different source identities unless those identities are part of the key.
Full rebuild must reconstruct from the same context and yield a state equal to incremental parsing for the same decoded prefix.
Liveness receipts must record source-context identity and current reference field/substate without copying source text.
complexity_and_liveness_boundaries: A source with B UTF-8 boundaries has B-1 start choices and B(B-1)/2 valid non-empty start/end pairs.
Choices should be represented as prefix tries over decimal literals rather than materializing repeated token-vocabulary intersections per pair.
The existing general STRING cache canonicalization must not be used for offset or SHA literal states.
A bounded zero-inference performance candidate must prove construction, allowed-set, cache, and full-rebuild liveness before any model probe.

Maximum ledger instances can contain 8 construction refs, 8 candidate refs, up to 8 authority refs, and 16 vehicle refs; worst-case 40 reference objects must be tested independently of Case 01's five.
what_remains_post_generation_only: Whether selected spans semantically anchor the claimed proposition or creative vehicle.
Whether commitment and semantic_target descriptions are accurate and exhaustive.
Overlap and reconciliation meaning beyond interval arithmetic.
Event alignment, modality, timing, factual support, target class, construction role, and coverage truth.
Owner quality and Gate S specificity/portability.
zero_inference_acceptance_requirements_f: Every accepted reference prefix can complete to at least one exact non-empty source slice.
Every completed reference resolves successfully with the approved pure resolver.
Wrong role, wrong SHA-256, mid-codepoint, end<=start, out-of-range, leading-zero, and cross-source completions have zero accepted paths.
Incremental and full-rebuild states and allowed character sets are equivalent for exhaustive small fixtures and sampled captured prefixes.
Context/cache isolation holds across two cases with identical lengths but different SHA-256 identities.
Canonical V2 output validates strictly, projects completely, and retains semantic validation as a distinct later phase.
No tokenizer/model/provider/inference call is required to establish character-DFA correctness; tokenizer-trie compatibility, if later authorized, remains zero inference and separately receipted.
explicit_non_goals: No grammar, DFA, tracker, controller, projector, prompt, evaluator, runner, or runtime code in this step.
No evaluator rebinding, probe construction, tokenizer load, model load, provider call, inference, or Stage C.
No weakening of the pure resolver, projection receipt, semantic validators, or frozen V1 evidence.
